title: Decide how selected Resume should handle the post-ACK worktree metadata interval
outcome: The transient conservative selected-resume409 caused by post-ACK worktree metadata is explicitly accepted with user guidance, or repaired without allowing stale/replaced prompt content to resume.
acceptance: A product/UI owner decides and records whether the conservative refresh refusal is acceptable; if changed, the decision preserves exact queued-prompt ownership and stale/replacement rejection.
A deterministic post-ACK interleave demonstrates the chosen behavior, preserving prompt content, historical receipt data, durability fences and no duplicate handoff.
